name: Camp Carilion
what_you_do: Four-day camp with hands-on practice of life-saving skills, CPR training, nursing skills, operating room instruments and many health careers.
who_can_apply: Students entering 10th, 11th or 12th grade who may want a future career in healthcare. Download the camp form for the full qualifications and paperwork.
pay_detail: Cost not stated on the page read.
deadline_text: 2026 applications were due Apr 3, 2026. Camp ran June 16 to 19, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Download the camp application form from the Carilion news page, then follow its instructions. Contact the camp directors at lmfreeman@carilionclinic.org or krproctor@carilionclinic.org.
notes: The camp is in Roanoke, not Blacksburg. 2027 dates are not posted; check the Carilion camps news page in early 2027.
